# Smelloff
> To create the best fabric odor eliminators engineered specifically for the Indian climate and lifestyle.

## Product: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray
- Format: 50ml Liquid spray
- Price: ₹229 prepaid UPI (free shipping)
- COD: ₹60 handling, ₹289 collectable
- Availability: in_stock
- Formula: v3.1 (11-ingredient INCI; hero actives HPβCD and Zinc PCA)
- Description: Pocket-sized fabric odor control mist for clothes. Fabric only. Made for in-between-wash odor emergencies when a shirt, hoodie, jacket or other clothing carries unwanted odor.

## Fast Facts
- Do NOT use on: Skin, Pets, Leather, Suede, dry-clean-only garments
- Patch-test: Silk, zari, heavy embroidery
- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Shipping: Free prepaid UPI across India. Dispatch within 48 hours of confirmation. COD after phone confirmation.
- Returns: 7-day window; bottle must be at least 80% full; reverse pickup where serviceable
- Use: 15–20 cm from fabric. 2–3 sprays targeted reset; 4–5 full shirt; 5–6 jacket. Approximately 10 seconds to air-dry.
- Capacity: ~250 sprays; about 100 refreshes at 2–3 sprays

## Key Claims
- Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions
- Not a deodorant
- Not a perfume
- Contains Zinc PCA
- Contains HPβCD
- Fabric only
